title: Full-time Faculty Position in Economics (Microeconomics and Applied Microeconomics)
industry: Microeconomics (JEL D), Economics, Economics and Social Sciences
text:
Job details
Teaching and administrative responsibilities:
Teaching undergraduate courses in Economics and related areas (Faculty members are expected to teach five "koma" per semester, with one "koma" being a 105-minute class meeting per week.) The teaching load includes:Behavioral Economics (EC3019) or Industrial Economics (EC3099)
Microeconomics (EC2066) or “Mathematics 1 (MT105a - Half course) and Statistics 1(ST104a - Half course)”
Other undergraduate lectures and seminars

Contributing to administration and curriculum development of SLAS.
Duties pertaining to university entrance examinations and committees.
Academic supervision and pastoral care of students.
Work location
176-8534 Tokyo 1-26-1, Toyotama-kami, Nerima-ku, Tokyo 176-8534 Japan
Wages
The salary will be determined based on academic background, teaching career, and work experience, as per the school's regulations.
Application requirements
Qualifications:
Ph.D. in Economics or a closely related field required at the time of appointment.
Must have sufficient command of English to effectively teach undergraduate courses in English. Proficiency in Japanese preferred.
Application period
2026/07/02 - 2026/10/31 Deadline for receipt
